canonical_source_policy.rule: The release archive must be generated from this source tree by tools/build_release.py; generated bytecode and transient evidence are excluded.

bridge_contract.scope: JSON parsing, schema checks, process result handling, caller/environment/session correlation, and fail-closed behavior under mocked or local subprocess conditions.

android_evidence_harness.scope: Two-run bridge execution, raw evidence retention, SHA-256 sidecar generation, activation persistence evaluation, bind/kernel/correlation checks, and fail-closed exit status.

required_checks: PRoot launches the selected rootfs on the target Android device
Required guest bind paths are visible and readable
Activation marker persists across independent launches
ETumax captures and validates the bridge envelope
Timeout, cancellation, and Android process lifecycle behavior are acceptable
Storage and permissions behave correctly on the target Android version

artifact_note: The final ZIP SHA-256 is written to the sidecar ETROUTE_RELEASE.json after the archive is built. Embedding the final archive hash inside the archive would be self-referential.
